descriptions.w3d_d24h_order_insert_800c54d0: Sorted insert into the id vector 0x8043e448: scans for the first id whose table entry (0x804a85d8, read with 0x800f7508) has an order above the given one, then inserts the id there with the inlined STLport-shaped vector insert: in-place shift with memmove, or overflow growth to size + max(size, 1) with the 0x80212fd4 allocator and 0x803413d8 fallback.
